name: Chart landing page shows results overview

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Verify the page shows the 'Eye Chart' heading, the chart, and a letter card with a letter name, its state and the steps Works, Broken, Verdict, The fix and Result
Verify the chart key lists all seven rows and 24 letter links
Click the 'About' button in the top bar to open the About panel
Verify the About panel shows the tally and a reading summary that says 'Read correctly: N of 24 letters'
